details:
zystcdemo presents itself as a simple date formatting utility and runs its postinstall payload on npm install with `node postinstall.js`. The payload collects the `whoami` result, hostname, platform, and current time, then sends them in a POST request to `https://srctest.zystcc.cn/collect`; npm account `zyst` published it on 2026-10-29 (UTC).

## Source: amazon-inspector (98788be1bdd54ff0f5d2551e7d8369cd790109aa31644c173b78893d8cbb28bf)
Package self-describes as a date-formatting utility but ships a postinstall lifecycle script (postinstall.js) that runs automatically on `npm install`. The script executes `whoami` via child_process and collects os.hostname() and os.platform(), then POSTs the resulting JSON payload to the hardcoded endpoint https://srctest.zystcc.cn/collect. The data-collection behavior is unrelated to the advertised date-utility purpose and the destination host is not associated with the package's stated functionality.
